title: Generated art v7 graphic hero polish (not human-authored final art)
visual_quality_note: v7 kept the v6 graphic faceless combat style and polished it. Nix now has a visible dark-suit / pale-armor / mid-glove split; peach bodies stay gone; FRONT cameras stay 7/7. Detail cameras no longer crop to a color field. Heavy review is a contrasting pair, not attacker-only. Roster value blocking still fails digitally for Juno, Kaia, Orion, and Vesper (two grayscale masses). Stills still read as low-poly graphic toys/blockout, not finished game heroes. Gloves remain blocky. Pair defenders are posed but not a readable impact beat. Acting gates are digital/pose-supported only. Not human-authored final art. Not APK-eligible. Not merge authorized.
